text:
The median asking rent in the Mettmann district sits at 10.8 €/m² in June 2026, up 6.2 % year‑on‑year and 25.6 % over the past five years, placing the market at rank 22 of the 37 most expensive German cities.  

With a vacancy rate of 1.6 % and an average of 29 days on market, the sector is described as balanced; 24 % of listings are let within a week. Asking rents are about 50 % above the 2022 existing rent of 7.21 €/m², while a typical 60 m² unit costs 648 € per month and the rent‑burden for two residents is 12.5 %.  

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 11.31 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 11.0 and 11.56 €/m², a change of 4.7 %.
